To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the optimum bridge inspection/repair arrangements are different depending on the utility functions of bridge owners and the time-dependent reliability of bridge structure.

the optimum bridge inspection and repair arrangement is determined by maximizing a utility function describing owners’ financial capacity, and risk adverse psychology, under a condition that the time-dependent reliability of a bridge is not larger than target reliability behind the design specification.

the optimum inspection/repair arrangement for deteriorating RC bridges is different from that based only on direct monetary rewards, and is determined on the basis of time-dependency of reliability of the bridges, utility functions relating owners' financial capacity and risk adversity, and the pre-posterior decision method.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a methodology for optimum inspection and repair arrangement of deteriorating concrete bridges.

the time-dependent reliability of RC bridges, the optimization of bridge inspection/repair arrangements based on the time-dependent reliability, and the decision analysis for bridge inspection/repair.

the optimum bridge inspection/repair arrangements based on the time-dependent reliability of RC bridges due to corrosion induced by chloride and carbonation, and the pre-posterior decision method is developed for the optimum bridge inspection/replacement decision.

the bridge inspection/ repair arrangement based on time-dependent reliability and pre-posterior decision can be optimized by using utility functions describing owners’ financial capacity, risk-adverse psychology and the bridge time-dependent reliabilities.

the optimization of the inspection/repair arrangement of deteriorating RC bridge based on time-dependent reliability is useful and effective to the owners and bridge users, and it is necessary to consider the utility function relating financial capacity and risk psychology in addition to direct reward.
the bridge inspection/ repair arrangement based on the utility of bridge inspection/repair is more rational and realistic than the one based on the direct monetary reward.

the bridge inspection/ repair arrangement based on the pre-posterior decision method can be used as an effective tool to improve the bridge management and safety level.
